theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역

theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.summary: Gold steadied after a two-day drop as the US and Iran exchanged strikes for the first time in a month, raising the odds of rising energy costs pushing up inflation and pressuring the Federal Reserve to lift interest rates.

top_news.title: Australia’s Beetaloo Shale Gas Could Power Northern Territory AI Data Centers

top_news.title: US Funds Alcoa Gallium Plant in Australia to Cut China Reliance
top_news.summary: The US Department of War said it will provide $174 million in financing to Alcoa Corp. to build a gallium plant at its alumina refinery in Western Australia, as Washington seeks to reduce its reliance on China for critical minerals.

top_news.title: UK Shop Price Inflation Hits Two-Year High After Energy Spike
top_news.summary: Prices in British shops rose at the fastest rate in more than two years last month, as the fallout from the Middle East conflict started to filter through to supermarket shelves.
